releases.body:
Initial public release of opencode-cd.

- Change the current OpenCode session directory from the TUI.
- Preserve conversation history when moving across projects.
- Move child sessions and rebuild parent links.
- Verify imported sessions before removing the source tree.
- Keep uncommitted source-directory changes in place.

Requires OpenCode 1.18.0 or newer. Cross-project moves require Bun and the OpenCode CLI.
